tree.label: Pages
tree.workspaceEmpty: Pages everyone here can read and write.
tree.privateEmpty: Only you see these, until you share one.

empty.title: Write it down once
empty.body: Notes, plans and checklists, next to your mail and tasks. Link a page to an email, a task or an event with @.

screen.label: Page
screen.inTrash: This page is in the trash.
screen.emptyBody: Choose one from the list, or write a new one.
screen.missingBody: It may have been deleted, or it was never shared with you.

share.title: Share {{title}}
share.placeWorkspaceNote: Anyone here can read and edit this page.
share.placePrivateNote: Only the people below can open it.
share.mentions: Mentioning someone in a page doesn’t share it with them.
share.syncedNote: Edits here go to Notion through {{name}}’s connection.
share.syncedMentions: Mentions are sent to Notion as a plain “Campbooks link”, never with their subject.

trash.label: Pages in the trash
trash.note: Pages here are deleted for good after 30 days.
trash.emptyBody: Pages you delete wait here for 30 days.
trash.purgeWarning: Delete {{title}} and its sub-pages for good? This can’t be undone.

toast.createFailed: Couldn’t create the page. Nothing was saved.
toast.renameFailed: Couldn’t rename the page. Nothing was changed.
toast.trashFailed: Couldn’t move {{title}} to the trash. Nothing was changed.
toast.shareFailed: Couldn’t change access for {{name}}. Nothing was changed.

import.title: Import from Notion
import.lead: These are the pages you shared with Campbooks in Notion. Sub-pages come along.
import.info: Blocks Campbooks doesn’t have yet (synced blocks, columns, embeds, databases) come across as a “Kept in Notion” box: you see them, they stay intact in Notion, and editing them happens there.
import.truncated: Notion lists more pages than are shown here. Share fewer pages in Notion to see the rest.

empty.title: No pages shared yet
empty.lead: In Notion, choose “Select pages” for Campbooks, then come back.

noConnection.title: Connect Notion first
noConnection.lead: Campbooks needs your Notion connection to list your pages.

needs_reauth.title: Notion needs you to connect again
needs_reauth.lead: Reconnect Notion in Settings, then come back to import.

rate_limited.title: Notion asked us to slow down
rate_limited.lead: Wait a minute, then try again.

not_connected.title: This Notion connection isn’t yours
not_connected.lead: Only the member who connected Notion can import its pages.

unavailable.title: Notion couldn’t be reached
unavailable.lead: Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.

import.tooMany: Pick at most {{max}} pages at a time.

sync.label: Sync with Notion
sync.waiting: Linked to Notion, waiting for the first sync

reason.trashed_here: Not synced: the page was moved to the trash
reason.trashed_in_notion: Not synced: the page is in the trash in Notion
reason.not_shared: Not synced: the page isn’t shared with Campbooks in Notion any more
reason.member_left: Not synced: the member who connected Notion left
reason.notion_unavailable: Not synced: Notion isn’t available on this instance
reason.other: Not synced with Notion any more

sync.stopQuestion: Stop keeping this page in step with Notion? The page stays here and the Notion page is left alone. Starting again is an import.
sync.stopFailed: Couldn’t stop syncing. Nothing was changed.

conflict.label: A change from Notion
conflict.changed: Changed in Notion, while you were editing it here
conflict.removed: Removed in Notion, while you were editing it here
conflict.removedBody: Notion no longer has this block. Keep it here, or remove it too.
conflict.footer: Changes to different paragraphs merge on their own; only the same one needs a choice.

resolved.both: Kept both, one under the other

conflict.done: {{what}} — it goes to Notion on the next sync.
conflict.failed: Couldn’t apply that choice. Nothing was changed.
conflict.undoFailed: Couldn’t undo that choice. Nothing was changed.

kept.title: Kept in Notion · {{what}}
kept.body: Campbooks shows it but doesn’t edit it yet; it stays exactly as it is in Notion.
